lines.en: if gpmexf == True:
scene gpmexf1 with dissolve
: Hmm...
scene gpmexf2 with dissolve
: What’s wrong, Akira? We’ve already been over here.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Akira？我们已经来过这边了。

lines.en: : You’re not lost already, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会已经迷路了吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. I know exactly what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。

lines.en: else:
scene gpmexf1 with dissolve2
$ renpy.pause(2, hard=True)
scene gpmexf2 with dissolve2
: Holy smokes! These flowers are so huge and fragrant! And so beautiful that I only {i}kind{/i} of want to set this field on fire.
lines.zh: : 我的天！这些花又大又香！而且美到我只{i}有那么一点{/i}想把这整片田野点着。

lines.en: : Think about the frog, Amy. I can’t imagine he’d be very happy knowing that the meadow inside of his stomach was set ablaze by a girl with only half of her appendages.
lines.zh: : 想想那只青蛙，Amy。我可想象不出，知道自己肚子里的草地被一个只剩一半肢体的女孩点着了，他会多高兴。

lines.en: : Well, if you won’t let me set anything on fire, what if we just frolicked together?
lines.zh: : 那好吧，既然你不让我点火，那我们干脆一起在草地上撒欢怎么样？

lines.en: : Oh! Or we could have a picnic! Some of these flowers look really tasty, right? Like that big triangular one off in the distance.
lines.zh: : 哦！或者我们可以野餐！有些花看起来真的很好吃，对吧？比如远处那个大大的三角形。

lines.en: : The tree? You can’t eat trees, Amy.
lines.zh: : 那棵树？树不能吃，Amy。

lines.en: : Oh, really? That’s sad. They look so tasty. And I always find myself enjoying triangular food the most.
lines.zh: : 哦，真的？好可惜。它们看起来那么好吃。而且我向来最喜欢吃三角形的食物。

lines.en: : Like...pizza? I’m struggling to really think of any other triangular food at the moment.
lines.zh: : 比如……披萨？我现在真想不出还有别的什么三角形食物。

lines.en: : There are those little sandwiches people serve you at special events too! Which, come to think of it, we should probably be eating right now!
lines.zh: : 还有那种在特别活动上招待的小三明治！说起来，我们现在大概就该在吃那个！

lines.en: : What kind of grand opening doesn’t come with tiny triangular sandwiches to- oh!
lines.zh: : 哪有开业典礼不配小三明治来——哦！

lines.en: : They must {i}want{/i} us to eat the trees! Or maybe the sandwiches are growing on the trees!
lines.zh: : 他们肯定是{i}想{/i}让我们吃那些树！或者说不定三明治就长在树上！

lines.en: scene gpmexf3
: {size=-10}Come on, Akira! Let’s go check together!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-10}来嘛，Akira！我们一起去看看！{/size}

lines.en: : Sandwiches don’t grow on trees, Amy.
lines.zh: : 三明治不长在树上，Amy。

lines.en: : {size=-10}But this isn’t a normal tree! And I think it’s reasonable to assume that some of the bugs swallowed by the frog could get stuck on them since they’re the pointiest thing around!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-10}但这可不是普通的树！而且我觉得可以合理假设，被青蛙吞下去的虫子有些会卡在上面，因为它们是附近最尖的东西！{/size}

lines.en: : I don’t want to eat bugs, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我不想吃虫子。

lines.en: scene gpmexf4 with hpunch
: Why? They’re super good for you. And they’ll do wonders for what’s happening to your skin.
lines.zh: : 为什么？它们对你特别有好处。而且对你皮肤上正在发生的事会有奇效。

lines.en: : Wait, what’s happening to my skin?
lines.zh: : 等等，我皮肤怎么了？

lines.en: : Nothing {i}bad!{/i} You’re just becoming more like me the longer you spend in here.
lines.zh: : 不是{i}坏事！{/i}你只是在这儿待得越久，就越变得像我。

lines.en: : Like, who knows? Maybe soon, I’ll have to go into your mouth and remove some of {i}your{/i} teeth as well! Hahah!
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢？说不定很快我也得钻进你嘴里，把{i}你{/i}的牙也拔掉几颗！哈哈！

lines.en: : I guess it wouldn’t be {i}that{/i} bad becoming more like you. I {i}am{/i} really enjoying my time in the mall so far.
lines.zh: : 我想变得像你也不算{i}那么{/i}糟。到目前为止我在商场里确实{i}很{/i}开心。

lines.en: : Right?! Like, it already {i}had{/i} everything a person could ever need, and now we’ve got a whole {i}other{/i} section that feels just like some other world!
lines.zh: : 对吧？！它本来就{i}有{/i}一个人可能需要的所有东西，而现在我们又多了一整块{i}另外的{/i}区域，感觉就像另一个世界！

lines.en: : To think that this place is still growing even {i}now...{/i}
lines.zh: : 想想这地方{i}现在{/i}都还在生长……

lines.en: : It just makes me so happy.
lines.zh: : 这真让我太开心了。

lines.en: : But the best part of all is being able to experience it with you.
lines.zh: : 但最棒的部分是能跟你一起体验它。

lines.en: scene gpmexf5
: You wouldn’t want to, like...
lines.zh: : 你不会想，那个……

lines.en: : {i}Kiss{/i} me...
: Would you?
lines.zh: : 真的会吗？

lines.en: scene gpmexf2
: S-Sorry! That was stupid of me. The first date is still too early for stuff like that, obviously! Hahahah...haha........hah.
lines.zh: : 抱……抱歉！我太蠢了。第一次约会做那种事当然还太早！哈哈哈……哈哈…………哈。

lines.en: : Aaaaaaaah!
lines.zh: : Aaaaaaaah!

lines.en: scene gpmexf3
: {size=-10}I’m so embarrassed! I’ll be over near the tree if you need me!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-10}我太丢脸了！如果你需要我，我就在树那边！{/size}

lines.en: Amy’s really cute when she wants something...
lines.zh: Amy 想要什么东西的时候真的很可爱……

lines.en: But there are people outside of here...where {i}I{/i} come from...that I need to be thinking about instead.
lines.zh: 但这里外面……{i}我{/i}来的那个地方……有我需要去想的人。

lines.en: I can’t get {i}too{/i} distracted or I’ll never want to leave.
lines.zh: 我不能{i}太{/i}分心，不然我就再也不想离开了。

lines.en: : {size=-10}J...Just let me know when you’re ready to go somewhere else!{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-10}你……你准备好去别的地方就告诉我一声！{/size}
